literal_meaning: প্যাঁচ কাটা বা খেলার ঘুঁটি নাড়ানো (moving or arranging pawns/knots)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা ঘুঁটি চালিয়ে ব্যবসায়ের লাভ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: They employed tactics to gain profit in business.
Skill in maneuvering is needed in politics.
note: Refers to strategic moves akin to board games like chess in Bengali culture
